# Shri Ganesh Polymer

> Delhi-based manufacturer of PC (polycarbonate), ABS and PBT engineering polymer granules. ISO 9001 & ISO 14001 certified, MSME registered, RoHS compliant. 15+ years in business, 5000+ MT annual capacity, 500+ industrial clients and 105+ distributors across India.

Granules are compounded in-house on twin and single screw extruders and every batch is tested in our own lab (melt flow index, impact, tensile, specific gravity, ash content and colour). Standard, flame-retardant, extrusion and glass-filled grades are available, with custom colour matching.

## Products

- [PC Granules (Polycarbonate)](https://www.shriganeshpolymer.in/products/pc/): LED panels, switches & sockets, chargers, CCTV housings, meter boxes
- [ABS Granules (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene)](https://www.shriganeshpolymer.in/products/abs/): electrical plugs, gang boxes, keyboards, set-top boxes, junction boxes
- [PBT Glass Filled (Polybutylene Terephthalate)](https://www.shriganeshpolymer.in/products/pbt/): terminal blocks, MCB housings, LED bulb bodies, lamp holders, B22 caps
- [All products and grade comparison](https://www.shriganeshpolymer.in/products/)
